entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have the order number?
It's VF77819. For the ProFit Jersey.
Thank you. I have the order pulled up. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size.
Okay, I see. When you say wrong size, is it a technical fault with the item, or more of a preference issue?
It's just too tight. I can't wear it.
I understand, comfort is definitely key. I see here the order was delivered 26 days ago. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.
Fine.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed that our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can process this for you right now. Would you like to do an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer a refund?
An exchange? No thanks. I'll just get the refund.

A refund it is. I have started the process on my end. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You can simply print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at your local post office.
Whatever. When do I get the money back?
Once our warehouse receives and inspects the jersey, the refund will be processed to your original payment method. That typically takes 5 to 7 business days from the time they receive it.
Right. I guess that's it, then.
Yes, it is. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
